description: Repo-local Copilot CLI hooks for the karta checkout: run the dev-repo commit gates scripts/hooks/precommit_gate.py and scripts/hooks/roundtable_gate.py on Bash tool calls. Each entry sets KARTA_HOOK_SOURCE=copilot so the gates run once: the legacy .claude/settings.json copies exit 0 under Copilot when that marker is absent. The bash launcher is fail-open (no repo or no gate script allows); the PowerShell entry goes through .codex-plugin/hooks/launch_hook.ps1 and carries the gate's exit code out with a trailing exit $LASTEXITCODE.

hooks.bash: sh -c 'r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; g="$r/scripts/hooks/precommit_gate.py"; [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$g" ] && exec python3 "$g"; exit 0'
sh -c 'r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; g="$r/scripts/hooks/roundtable_gate.py"; [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$g" ] && exec python3 "$g"; exit 0'
